description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, providing public endpoints for welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic public endpoints for the backend service.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the backend is running under Spring Boot.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects clients to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check endpoint returning 'OK'.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic application information indicating the app name.
